templateOptions.label: BaseUrl
templateOptions.description: The URL to the Officient API.

templateOptions.label: Access token
templateOptions.description: The access token used as a bearer token. See the README for the required scopes.

templateOptions.label: Include archived persons
templateOptions.description: When toggled, archived persons are imported as well. This increases the number of API calls.

templateOptions.label: Use wage history for contracts
templateOptions.description: When toggled, the wage history periods of a person are used as contracts. This needs the wages:read scope, which exposes salary data (it is not imported). When off, one contract per person is built from the employment dates.

templateOptions.label: Toggle debug logging
templateOptions.description: When toggled, extra logging is shown. Note that this is only meant for debugging, please switch this off when in production.
